rag_principle.concept: Old stale printed pages = RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) for AI
rag_principle.how: Physical documents carry context that digital files may have lost (handwritten notes, physical state, timestamp of printing)
rag_principle.value: Each scanned page is BOTH a unique physical artifact AND a knowledge input
rag_principle.bingoCube: Each page hashed uniquely — no two scans identical — the physical world IS the randomness source
